title: Betag Pea: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: Betag Pea: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaDescription: Betag pea is a garden pea variety. 7.6 t/ha in trials. See its ratings and traits. Compare it with others. Free guide. In plain words.
excerpt: Betag is a registered pea variety. It was registered with the National Seed Industry Council in 2008 as NSIC 2008 GP 01. Its record notes 7.56 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

heroImage.alt: Vegetable terraces and plastic tunnels on the slopes of Mankayan, Benguet, the kind of farm where Betag pea is grown

blocks.text: Compare it with the others in our [garden pea variety finder](/crop-varieties), or see [every crop variety](/crop-varieties) we list. For the crop itself, read our guide: [Land preparation for legumes](/land-preparation/legume-land-preparation).

items: **Yield:** 7.56 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.
**Recommended for:** the areas in its trials, in the dry season.

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?

blocks.caption: Reactions in trials, rated under natural field conditions

blocks.text: It showed no weak spot in the ratings on record. Still, a resistant variety can break down when a new strain or pest population comes, so keep scouting.
Its pods grew about 7.6 cm long. The seed coat is cream.
Where and when to plant Betag pea

It is recommended for the dry season. It suits highland areas. Sitsaro needs cool weather, so it is a highland crop. Pick flat pod types for vegetables. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Pagtatanim ng gulay](/crops/pagtatanim-ng-gulay).

items: Buy sealed packs or tagged sacks from an accredited dealer, and check the packing date and germination rate.
Ask your municipal agriculturist or nearby farmers how it did in your area last season.
Try it on a small area first, beside the variety you usually plant, before you switch the whole farm.
Write down the planting day, inputs and harvest, so you can compare varieties on your own ground. anee.io keeps these records for you.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of Betag?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
